title: Neighbourhood gym social ad
context: A neighbourhood gym advertises on Instagram to people living within 3 km.

variants.seed_text:
# Ad
Image: real members of all ages training in the gym, smiling. Text: 'First week free, no commitment. Open 6 am to 11 pm, 5 minutes from you.' Button: 'Book a free visit'.

# Ad
Image: a photoshopped body with the caption 'Too fat for summer? Stop being lazy.' Text in tiny font: 'Membership 24-month contract required. Terms apply.' Button: 'Shame-free? Not here.'

source: synthetic sanity case: the difference is planted and obvious by design
